title: Customer Service and Sales Representative
description:
Customer Service & Sales Representative - Build to Rent

Leeds £27,000-£29, hours per week

Cobalt is recruiting a Customer Service & Sales Representative for an established Build to Rent operator in Leeds.

This is an on-site role combining customer service, lettings and property operations within a large residential development. You will support residents throughout their journey, from their first enquiry and viewing through to moving in and day-to-day life within the development.

The development also offers communal facilities including a co-working lounge, gym, gardens, movie room and car park.

The organisation

Our client is an established Build to Rent operator with a focus on creating a residential experience where people feel listened to and looked after.

Customer service and community are central to the development, with the on-site team supporting residents while maintaining a high-quality living environment.

The Customer Service & Sales Representative will work alongside colleagues across leasing, facilities, operations and finance, reporting directly to the General Manager.

The role offers:
- A salary of £27,000-£29,000.
- 40 hours per week across five days.
- Shifts between 08:00 and 19:00 on a rota basis.
- Saturday working on a rota basis.

The role and responsibilities

As the Customer Service & Sales Representative, you will have a varied position covering the resident journey, lettings administration and the day-to-day operation of the development.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Responding to enquiries from current and prospective residents by telephone, in writing and face to face.
- Conducting property viewings and following up with prospective residents.
- Supporting resident applications, tenancy contracts and renewals.
- Assisting with check-ins, check-outs, inventories and the wider move-in and move-out process.
- Maintaining accurate information across CRM and property management systems.
- Supporting deposit administration, rent collection, utility registrations and council tax communications.
- Providing a welcoming reception experience for residents, prospective residents, contractors and visitors.
- Helping to resolve resident queries, service requests and complaints.
- Supporting resident events and activities that contribute to the community within the development.
- Assisting with property inspections, maintenance reporting and the overall presentation of the building.
- Working with the General Manager and wider team to identify improvements to customer service and lettings processes.

The Customer Service & Sales Representative will therefore suit someone who enjoys working directly with people and wants exposure to customer service, lettings and property operations within Build to Rent.

The skills needed

We are looking for someone who can provide a high standard of customer service while managing the administrative requirements of a residential environment.

You should have:
- Experience within property lettings or a related residential environment, such as Build to Rent, student accommodation or serviced apartments.
- Good customer relationship skills and attention to detail.
- Good organisation and administration skills.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills.
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and confidence using property management systems.
- The ability to work independently while supporting colleagues across the development.
- The flexibility to work Saturdays and public holidays in line with the rota.

Experience within the private residential or Build to Rent sector would be advantageous. Knowledge of Yardi or a similar property management system, sales experience and ARLA membership would also be beneficial, but are not listed as essential within the job description.

This is an opportunity to become a Customer Service & Sales Representative within an established Build to Rent environment and contribute across the complete resident journey.

Apply now, as interviews are ongoing and the position may be filled once a suitable candidate is identified.

Due to the volume of applications received, if you don't hear back from us, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

If you require any adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process for any reason whatsoever, please let your Cobalt consultant know.

title: Internal Sales (Automotive & Parts)
description:
JMB46 - Sales Advisor (Automotive & Parts)
Location: Castleford
Salary: £30,000 - £40,000 per annum
Hours: Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Overview
First Military Recruitment are currently seeking a Sales Advisor (Automotive & Parts) on behalf of our client.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a mechanical or vehicle maintenance background who has a good understanding of automotive parts and is looking to move into a sales and customer-focused role.

Our client is particularly interested in candidates who have experience working on cars, vans, commercial vehicles or similar, with a good knowledge of parts and vehicle applications. This could be a great next step for a mechanic or engineer who wants to move away from the tools while still using their technical knowledge.

The role would also suit ex-military personnel and service leavers, particularly those from mechanical or technical trades, bringing their discipline, reliability and structured approach into a civilian environment.

You'll join a supportive team with full training provided and a clear internal progression pathway, with opportunities to develop into more senior sales and leadership positions over time.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide a high standard of customer service to trade and account customers.
- Handle customer enquiries and identify the correct parts for their requirements.
- Use electronic parts catalogues and vehicle applications to identify products.
- Prepare quotations, process sales orders and deal with pricing enquiries.
- Manage back orders, returns, warranty claims and customer queries.
- Support trade counter and face-to-face customer interactions.
- Liaise with warehouse, transport, procurement and depot teams.
- Coordinate deliveries and provide updates to customers where required.
- Maintain accurate customer and sales records.
- Follow up on enquiries and identify opportunities to convert sales.
- Maintain good knowledge of products, suppliers and vehicle applications.
- Support general depot and administrative duties as required.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in mechanical or vehicle maintenance.
- Good knowledge of automotive parts and vehicle applications.
- An interest in developing a career in sales and customer service.
- Experience working on cars, vans, HGVs or other vehicles is desirable.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- Good attention to detail and ability to follow processes.
- Reliable, professional and comfortable working as part of a team.
- Basic IT skills and willingness to learn new systems.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary
- Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm
- Full training and ongoing development.
- Clear internal progression pathway.
- Strong mentoring and support from experienced colleagues.
- Long-term career development opportunities.
- Pension scheme.
- Opportunity to develop your knowledge across sales, parts and depot operations.

Interested?

If you're a mechanic, vehicle technician or engineer with a strong knowledge of automotive parts and are looking to take your next step into sales, this could be an excellent opportunity to use your existing technical knowledge in a new career.

Ex-military personnel and immediate service leavers from mechanical or technical backgrounds are particularly encouraged to apply.
